classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is a contemporary administrative file documenting the parliamentary debate on extending collective labor agreements during the Autumn session of 1982.
classification.resume: This is an audio recording of a debate in the Swiss National Council on 8 October 1982 concerning the extension of collective labour agreements. It documents the presentation of a postulate by Ziegler-Solothurn on the general applicability of labour conventions. The record captures parliamentary proceedings rather than reporting on them.
